questions.q: Where does a raw street address live, before it's associated with any party?
options: HZ_PARTIES
HZ_LOCATIONS
POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M
HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL
questions.explain: HZ_LOCATIONS stores the raw address data independent of any party, which allows the same address to be reused by more than one party.

options: A general ledger account combination
A customer's bill-to usage of a site
A supplier's pay-site flag
A specific party's use of a specific location
questions.explain: HZ_PARTY_SITES is the generic link between a party and a location, representing that party's use of the address.

questions.q: Why might fixing a wrong address require more than one table update?
options: Because the same address can be represented at the raw location level, the generic party-site level, and again in product-specific site tables layered on top
Because HZ_LOCATIONS is deleted automatically after use
Because only one table ever stores any address
Because addresses are never stored in Oracle Fusion
questions.explain: A real-world address can appear as a raw location, a party site, and then again in supplier- or customer-specific site tables — the actual error could be in any of those layers.

questions.q: How is an individual contact represented in the data model?
options: Contacts are not stored in Oracle Fusion at all
As a row in a completely separate CONTACTS table with no relation to HZ_PARTIES
As a party of type Person in HZ_PARTIES, linked to organizations via HZ_RELATIONSHIPS and HZ_ORG_CONTACTS
As a column directly on the supplier table
questions.explain: A contact is just a Person-type party in HZ_PARTIES; HZ_RELATIONSHIPS and HZ_ORG_CONTACTS capture the association to an organization and the person's role.

options: It stores the raw street address for every organization
It maps a person-party to an organization-party along with the role that person plays, such as billing contact
It replaces HZ_PARTIES entirely
It stores supplier bank account details
questions.explain: HZ_ORG_CONTACTS specifically records the relationship between a person and the organization they work for, including their role.
